purpose: Single refs-only reviewer handoff manifest for C01. It tells an external reviewer or artifact producer exactly which evidence packets to return, which validation commands to run, and which local evidence remains comparison-only before C01 verifier evidence can close.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: reviewer acceptance or rejection of the beta18 H6 source migration delta, including frozen source commit, source tree status, source freeze review, and reviewer identity/scope refs
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Source-review acceptance is a prerequisite for production artifact review, but it is not production proof/VK evidence, adapter acceptance, SBF/live lineage, audit acceptance, or C01 closure.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: refs-only output manifest for returned proof, public witness, production VK, source ACIR, and generated verifier SBF artifacts; raw proof, VK, witness, proving-key, keypair, and signed transaction bytes must stay out of repo evidence
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Output-manifest preflight can hash and shape-check returned artifacts before deterministic build review, but it is not production proof-format evidence, not production verifying-key evidence, not verifier-adapter acceptance, not SBF/live lineage, not audit acceptance, and not C01 closure.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: reviewed reproducible Sunspot/Gnark build receipt, frozen source commit/tree status refs, setup or toxic-waste mitigation refs, output manifest refs for proof, VK, public witness, verifier artifacts, and artifact producer/reviewer identity-scope attestation
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Deterministic artifact build acceptance is a prerequisite for artifact bundle review, but it is not verifier-adapter acceptance, SBF/live lineage, audit acceptance, or C01 closure.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: reviewed frozen source commit, production proof-format, VK hash, current H6 public-input binding, adapter, valid-proof mutation plus invalid-proof, wrong-public-input, wrong-verifying-key, and wrong-verifier-program no-mutation refs, lineage, audit refs, and artifact producer/reviewer identity-scope attestation in one refs-only production artifact bundle
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: The bundle must be reviewed and validated before promotion; this handoff manifest does not supply it.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: accepted verifier adapter or verifier program boundary, current H6 public-input binding, valid-proof mutation; invalid-proof, wrong-public-input, wrong-verifying-key, and wrong-verifier-program no-mutation refs, and reviewer identity-scope attestation
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Local unsafe adapter evidence and source seam tests do not satisfy production verifier-adapter acceptance.

reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Fresh local SBF ABI and local H6 SBF rehearsal are comparison evidence only, not SBF/live lineage.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: reviewer identity, scope, findings disposition, and explicit C01 acceptance refs after production bundle, adapter acceptance, valid-proof mutation plus invalid-proof, wrong-public-input, wrong-verifying-key, and wrong-verifier-program no-mutation, and SBF/live lineage exist
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Repo-local checks are not audit/reviewer acceptance.

reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Closure validation can only pass after reviewed returned packets exist; this handoff manifest is not C01 closure and remains blocked.
